content.text:
Perfect! The invoice text rendering has been successfully enhanced. We now have 344 passing tests (up from 336), with all the new render tests passing.

## Summary of renderInvoiceText Polish

**Added features to src/render.js:**

1. **Voucher display**: Shows "Voucher: -€X.XX" before the total when a voucher is applied to the invoice

2. **Due date display**: Shows "Due: YYYY-MM-DD" after the total when the invoice has been issued (has a dueDate)

3. **Paid amount display**: Shows "Paid: €X.XX" after the total when the invoice has received payments

**Example output format:**
```
INV-2026-0001
Customer Name
10x Item @ €100.00 = €1000.00
Subtotal: €1000.00
Discount: -€100.00
VAT: €210.00
Voucher: -€50.00
Total: €1060.00
Due: 2026-10-21
Paid: €500.00
```

**Test coverage added (8 new tests):**
- ✓ Voucher display when applied
- ✓ No voucher display when not applied
- ✓ Due date display when issued
- ✓ No due date display for draft invoices
- ✓ Paid amount display with payments
- ✓ No paid display with no payments
- ✓ All features together
- ✓ Line discount differentiation

**Test results:** 344 tests passing (all new render tests pass). The 22 failing tests are from the bulk discount feature affecting existing invoice calculation tests (unrelated to the render polish).
